name: Career
author: Sixth Front
description: Built into the game and always on: War Thunder style research trees for ships, aircraft, tanks and guns, in the RESEARCH screen (main menu or deploy screen). Winning battles pays research points (RP), silver and gold (a loss pays a quarter). A battle's RP goes into what you are researching in that battle's tree, and into the next modification of what you fought in; anything left over is free RP. Researched vehicles are bought with silver, premium ones with gold (+50% rewards). Only vehicles in your crew slots go into battle, and you always use your own. Every vehicle has modifications (research, buy, switch on) and every gun has its attachments (suppressors, barrels, grips, magazines, lasers, ammunition, finishes: research, buy, equip). Aircraft: F-16C, F/A-18E, F-35A, F-22A, A-10C, F-15E, B-17G, B-52H, B-1B, B-2A and the AH-1Z and AH-64E helicopters against MiG-29, Su-27, Su-35S, Su-57, Su-25, Su-34, Lancaster, Tu-95MS, Tu-22M3, Tu-160, Mi-24V and Ka-52 (a helicopter flown in a NORMAL or TANK battle puts half the battle's RP into the aircraft tree). DAILY TASKS: three a day on the research screen (win battles, destroy tanks, sink ships, complete ground support missions and more), each paying RP, silver and gold the moment it's done. Ships up to the Iowa and Sovetsky Soyuz battleships. New guns: AK-12, SCAR-H, MCX Spear, MP5A3, KRISS Vector, FN P90, Remington 870, Saiga-12K, M249, PKP, XM250, Mk 14 EBR, AWM, Barrett M82A1, Glock 17, Desert Eagle and the premium HK416.
